theory: The first fact and first step incorrectly say that all am times keep their hour, contradicting the midnight exception. Explicitly exclude the entire $12$ am hour and state that it becomes $00$; likewise, make clear that the entire $12$ pm hour stays $12$, rather than only noon itself. Complete the reverse-conversion step by covering hours $01$–$11$ as am and hour $12$ as pm, consistent with the booklet's conversion table.
summary: Replaced the ordering and alarm-comparison tasks with direct conversions, removed unsupported error-analysis demands from three retained items, and supplied booklet citations for all five affected items. Corrected the theory to cover the entire midnight and noon hours and every reverse-conversion case; no whole items were removed, and all other content and quiz questions were preserved.
reviewSummary: All 15 practice items and six quiz questions have correct answers, usable working and booklet-supported conversion tasks; every quiz has exactly one correct option and specific, consistent distractor explanations. The theory correctly handles midnight and noon throughout their hours, the tier minimums are met, and no worked examples or removals were supplied.
